gloss_en: "Sixty are the queens" (shishim hemah melakhot) — the scriptural phrase from Song of Songs 6:8, where melakhot means 'queens' (not 'kingdoms'), expounded in Likutey Moharan I:15 as the aspect of Avraham/Chesed and linked to the letter samekh (numerical value sixty) and the 'sixty houses' of Hagronya
